set.description: Pick the channel and start a word-chain round

reset.description: Start the word-chain round over, keeping the channel and the limit

channelOption.description: The channel you want to play in

maxWordsOption.description: Most words in a round, at least 200. Defaults to 1500.

start: The game has started! Send any single word to begin.
notConfigured: No game channel has been chosen yet!

reply.NOT_EXIST: This word is not in the dictionary
reply.NOT_LINK: The next word has to start with `{starter}`
reply.SAME_WORD: This word has already been played
reply.finished: The game is over: {maxWords} words reached. Reset it to play again
